overview.description: The Russell Investments Global Real Estate ETF (CRIB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in real estate equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking current income and long-term capital growth through exposure to global real estate companies of any market capitalization. The fund uses a multi-manager approach. CRIB was launched on Jun 22, 2026 and is issued by Russell Investments.
